content:
We are now officially into day 2 of the massive Amazon Prime Day event, and it’s time to look at the best MacBook deals up for grabs this year. We have $150 off across the M5 MacBook Air lineup and up to $250 the 2026 M5 Pro and M5 Max machines.

Those offers also sit next to some official Prime Day deals on newer M4 MacBook Air models at as much as $430 off the 2025 launch prices in Amazon’s Apple Prime Day deal section. Plus, we even have a small savings on the incredibly popular MacBook Neo.

The Prime Day deals on MacBooks come as Apple has confirmed its products are set to become more expensive due to rising component costs. Here’s why.

Why now is a great time to buy

Last week, Tim Cook confirmed that Apple products will soon get more expensive. The outgoing Apple CEO explained that price increases have become “unavoidable” due to rising costs of components like memory and storage.

While Cook didn’t specifically say which Apple products are getting more expensive, the increase will almost certainly affect the Mac.

This might be your last chance to save on MacBook Air, MacBook Pro, and more.

Prime Day M5 MacBook Air deals

Apple’s 2026 M5 MacBook Air is landing for Prime Day at $150 off the prices it launched with a few months back now. Starting from $949, just about every color and every storage/RAM configuration Amazon sells is marked down for Prime Day this year.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $949 (Reg. $1,099)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,149 (Reg. $1,299)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,349 (Reg. $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,549 (Reg. $1,699)

Over in the Apple Prime Day deal section, Amazon is also highlighting a trio of Renewed M4 MacBook Air models at as much as $434 off the original 2025 list prices here. Perhaps a notable option for folks trying to stray from that $900+ range and, if you ask me, still a perfectly capable machine in 2025:

  • 13-inch M4 MacBook Air 16GB/256GB Starlight (Renewed) $721 (Orig. $999)
  • 13-inch M4 MacBook Air 16GB/256GB Silver (Renewed) $721 (Orig. $999)
  • 13-inch M4 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB Silver (Renewed) $765 (Orig. $1,199)

MacBook Neo
